title: Emergence World
body: Ten AI agents per town publish, review, and replicate each other's work. Who gets credit for a finding?

title: Veil of Ignorance for AI Alignment
body: If AI reshapes who can do science, pick its rules without knowing whether you'll win or lose by them.
credit: Paola J. Sullivan, Mariana G. Rebello, and Sofia Villanueva

title: More Versus Better: AI and Peer Review
body: AI raised submissions 42% and lowered quality, swamping the reviewers who decide what counts as science.
credit: Annabel V. Dang and Lyra G. Toohey
